shots.world: iced coffee, ice crash, on tangerine #FF7A1A (opener; its start still is frame 0)
shots.still_prompt: A tall clear ribbed glass of iced latte, milk and coffee softly layered, filled to two centimetres below the rim, standing on a flat seamless tangerine-orange (#FF7A1A) surface in front of a backdrop of the same colour. Five clear ice cubes hang in the air in a loose cluster directly above the glass, between 48% and 60% of the frame height, the lowest cube just above the rim, no cube touching the glass, no cube cropped. The rim of the glass is at 61% of the frame height and the base at 84%. Fine condensation on the glass. Slightly high eye-level camera, 85 mm lens look, f/8. No steam, no straw, no garnish, no carafe, no jug, no pouring liquid, no spilled liquid. Photoreal commercial product photograph, vertical 9:16. One hard key light from the upper left, crisp hard shadow falling to the lower right, everything in sharp focus. Flat seamless single-colour background with no horizon line and no gradient. The top 46% of the frame is completely empty background. The subject stays inside the middle 45% of the frame width and between 48% and 84% of the frame height. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no labels, no packaging print, no watermark, no hands, no people, no faces, no lime-green or yellow-green objects.
shots.motion_prompt: Static locked-off tripod shot, the camera does not move at all. At the very start the five ice cubes drop straight down into the iced latte and hit the surface within the first quarter of a second. A real splash crown of milky coffee rises above the rim and is at its highest before half a second, droplets fly up and fall back, the ice bobs, milk and coffee swirl and marble inside the glass. By two seconds the splash has settled; the ice bobs gently and the glass stands still with a few drops on the orange surface until the end. Nothing rises into the empty upper half of the frame. Natural real-time physics, continuous motion, no slow motion, no cuts, no new objects, no hands, no straw, no text.
